Assessment of BA.evidence_source: Participants completed measures of actual-ideal weight discrepancy, body appreciation, and lifetime exposure to Western and Zimbabwean media.
Assessment of BA.warning: The specific instrument (BAS or BAS-2) for body appreciation was not mentioned.

Correlation between body appreciation an.evidence_source: In addition, weight discrepancy and body appreciation among both samples were significantly associated with exposure to Western media, but not Zimbabwean media.
Correlation between body appreciation an.warning: Correlations were reported for body appreciation with media exposure, not BMI.

section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a single study that investigated body image among 140 women in Harare, Zimbabwe, and 138 Zimbabwean migrants in Britain. It found that Zimbabwean women in Britain had significantly greater weight discrepancy and lower body appreciation than their counterparts in Zimbabwe. Both samples' body image measures were associated with Western media exposure.
